description: This file defines a React functional component called SkillsGrid, which displays a grid of interactive skill cards with optional sub-skill controls. It imports React and a SkillCard component, and renders a section containing headers and a list of SkillCards based on the provided skills data.

methods.name: SkillsGrid({ title = "Skills", subtitle = "Adjust sub-skill progress to update your readiness in real time.", skills = [], onSetSubSkillProgress, })
